200.title: Polish parliament approves ban on nighttime alcohol sales in shops
200.summary: Polish parliament approves ban on nighttime alcohol sales in shops Oct 9, 2026 | Business , Featured , Law , Politics , Society Keep our news free from ads and paywalls by making a donation to support our work!
200.body: Polish parliament approves ban on nighttime alcohol sales in shops Oct 9, 2026 | Business , Featured , Law , Politics , Society Keep our news free from ads and paywalls by making a donation to support our work! An overwhelming majority of MPs in the Sejm, the lower house of Poland’s parliament, have voted in favour of a bill that would introduce tough new anti-alcohol measures, including a ban on all forms of advertising and on sales in shops during nighttime hours. Almost 200 Polish municipalities, including large cities such as Warsaw and Kraków , have already introduced their own local bans on nighttime alcohol sales. They also drank 82 litres of beer, down 18.7% since 2018 https://t.co/FxFMupWLRv — Notes from Poland 🇵🇱 (@notesfrompoland) September 1, 2026 In June, an IBRiS poll for the Rzeczpospolita daily found that 55% of Poles support some form of ban on nighttime alcohol sales while 43% are opposed.

300.title: Poland: Inflation outlook stabilises – ING
300.summary: ING economists Adam Antoniak and David Havrlant expect Poland’s final September CPI, due Wednesday, to confirm headline inflation at 4% year-on-year, with core inflation easing and price growth concentrated in fuels and related services. They note improved short-term inflation prospects thanks to renewed cuts in fuel excise duty and VAT, and project headline CPI in a 3.5–4.0% range by year-end.

400.body: DLA Piper has advised Greenvolt Power on the negotiation of two long-term tolling agreements with Statkraft in relation to the Ełk and Turośń Kościelna battery energy storage system (BESS) projects in Poland. This matter provided another opportunity to draw on our experience across the energy sector, energy market regulation and complex contractual arrangements supporting the deployment and operation of energy storage assets. We would like to thank Greenvolt Power for its trust and congratulate all teams involved on the successful completion of this significant transaction.” LEGAL DESIRE NEWSLETTER Where the legal industry reads first.

500.body: During the Dots training, I asked Embiricos if i could get alidot to use a newsletter publishing tool we rely on at work. So, I asked the OpenAI executive, if I showed alidot the written instructions for this web-based newsletter tool, could my new AI agent get it done? I gave it an old version of my AI Insider newsletter, in the form of Google Doc, and told it to input all the content into the relevant parts of the newsletter tool. alidot sent a little pop-up bubble that I clicked on to add my password for this newsletter tool. But during the training session, Embiricos said OpenAI deliberately launched Dots in the more restrained environment of corporate technology.
